stem.text: A mass of $60.0\,\text{g}$ is suspended from a spring and the distance from the bottom of the spring to the floor is measured to be $16.4\,\text{cm}$.
The mass is replaced with a $100.0\,\text{g}$ mass and the distance from the bottom of the spring to the floor is now measured to be $12.6\,\text{cm}$. The spring obeys Hooke’s law.
What is the spring constant of the spring?
